purpose: A governed integration plan for using an owner-controlled Obsidian vault for cross-agent notes, research summaries, handoffs, and AURELIA operational documentation.

AURELIA.details: Obsidian capabilities are pinned in both source registries; the runtime does not yet have a live vault connection.

Claude.details: The skill is supplied for Claude Code through the repository; installation into an external/private Claude account is not asserted.

Grok.details: The skill is supplied through the repository's .grok skill path; account-level connection is not asserted.

ChatGPT.details: Can use repository docs and pinned source context. Live vault reads/writes require an explicitly configured client connector or user-provided approved integration.

DeveloperTools.details: Shared agent skill is included under .agents/skills for compatible developer-agent runners.

preferred_transport.authentication: Bearer API key stored locally in the user's client secret store
preferred_transport.tls: Verify TLS certificate; trust the plugin's local CA instead of disabling verification
preferred_transport.note: This repository version documents a built-in MCP server. Do not enable a second wrapper by default.

alternatives.note: Separate MCP wrapper for the Local REST API; not selected as primary because it overlaps the primary plugin's built-in MCP functionality.

installation_state.reason: No connected Obsidian instance/device or authenticated vault API was available. Obsidian account sign-in, where required for Obsidian Sync, must be completed by the owner through Obsidian's own secure sign-in flow.
